question: What is the authoritative view regarding the deities in the forty-nine pot arrangement?
premises: A configuration of forty-nine pots is specified.
Deities are assigned to this configuration.
This assignment is held as the accepted view.
inference: Therefore deities are considered to be present in the arrangement of forty-nine pots.
uncertainties: The specific identities of the deities are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: In the arrangement of forty-nine pots, the deities are considered to be present.
